name: claude-quote
description: Highlight something Claude said and a quote chip appears above the prompt: one click puts it in the prompt box as a > quote, ready to reference. Needs function hooks (early access), the fullscreen terminal (copy on select) and a clipboard tool (pbpaste, wl-paste or xclip).

reader.title: Clipboard command
reader.description: The command that prints the clipboard, words split on spaces (say `tmux save-buffer -`). Empty: the first of pbpaste, wl-paste and xclip that answers.

timeout.title: Seconds the quote card stays up
timeout.description: The card goes on its own after this many seconds. 0 keeps it until you quote, dismiss it, copy something else or send a prompt.
